messages:
ci-bot: Pipeline r/run-integ-1954321 failed (linux) — 6 failing tests. Logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/1954321/12345

lena: seeing repeated timeouts to mock-vault from the integration run. other services look fine. anyone oncall for infra? :thinking:

matt: yep, I pulled the job logs — mock-vault returns connection resets and 502s intermittently. quick log snippet:```
E 12:34:56.789 mock-vault: connection reset by peer
GET /v1/secret/mykey -> 502
net/http: timeout awaiting response headers
```

ryan: could be the mock-vault pod restarted during the run. did infra push a new image?

ops-bot: Alert: ci-mock-vault-3 in namespace ci-testing restarted (OOMKill) at 1954320900. Restart reason: OOMKilled.

matt: that matches. connection pools got dropped when the pod OOMed. tests have no retry so they fail hard.

lena: can someone rerun the failed job while we triage? need to know if it's transient. @sophia can you?

sophia: on it, kicking a rerun now: https://ci.redwood.internal/1954321/12345/rerun (job rerun id 1954321-2)

lena: thanks. in parallel: matt, do you want to bisect if this started after the mock-vault bump?

matt: I'll do a quick grep in the infra changelog. my hunch: mock-vault 2.4.0 added a new cache that uses more memory. rolling back to 2.3.x fixed a flaky run last week.

matt: filing a tiny note in the run: "suspect mock-vault OOM after 2.4.0" and will open infra ticket.

ci-bot: Rerun 1954321-2 finished: 3 tests still failed, 2 skipped (skipped due to "vault-unavailable" tag), overall: 79/82 passed.

ryan: ok, so not fully transient. recommend two short-term actions: 1) set a test-level retry around vault calls, 2) pin mock-vault to 2.3.x in CI images until infra fixes memory regression.

sophia: taking action item to open a quick PR to skip the most brittle e2e that depends on ephemeral secret streaming and add a task to unskip after infra fix. PR drafting now -> #5234

lena: please add a test TODO comment with the ticket number. we'll treat as flaky in the test tracker so it doesn't block merges.

ops-bot: Infra ticket created: INFRA-811 "mock-vault memory regression in 2.4.0 causing OOMs in CI" assigned to infra-team.

matt: also adding a small client retry in a follow-up PR so the integration harness tolerates a pod restart for a short window. will request review from @ryan.

sophia: PR #5234 opened to skip flaky e2e + add link to INFRA-811. tagging release lead.

lena: great — once infra pins the image and we have the PR, unskip and re-run full suite. thanks all. :heart:

ryan: one more ask to infra: can we add a k8s readiness probe to mock-vault so CI doesn't start tests until pod is fully ready? reduces noise.

ops-bot: noted in INFRA-811.

matt: quick note for postmortem: add a line about better resource limits and a prometheus alert on restart frequency for mock fixtures.

lena: agreed. creating a short follow-up doc after INFRA-811 is resolved.

sophia: leaving a comment on the PR with a manual rerun instruction. ping me if anyone sees more fails.

lena: thanks — marking thread resolved for now.

ci-bot: Reaction recorded: :white_check_mark:
